profile_chars.label: Profile length
profile_chars.hint: How much of your profile, the notes about you from setup, Aldwin reads.

persona_chars.label: Personality length
persona_chars.hint: How much of Aldwin's personality and answer style it reads.

notes_chars.label: Recent notes length
notes_chars.hint: How much of the notes Aldwin keeps between chats it reads.

notes_days.label: Recent notes days
notes_days.hint: How many days back of those notes Aldwin reads.

context_compact_percent.label: Summarise older messages at
context_compact_percent.hint: How full a chat gets, as a share of what the model can read, before Aldwin makes room by summarising older messages. Lower costs less per message; higher keeps more word for word.

max_steps.label: Steps per answer
max_steps.hint: The most actions (searching, reading a file, using an app) Aldwin takes for one message before it stops and reports back.

web_searches.label: Web searches per answer
web_searches.hint: The most times Aldwin searches the web for one message, so a single question can't use up your search engine's allowance.

connector_tools.label: App tools offered at once
connector_tools.hint: The most tools from your connected apps Aldwin can see at one time. Too many can confuse the model.

invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
fromFile: Your config.yaml sets {value}. You can set up to {max} here.

bar.label: Unsaved changes
bar.fix: Fix the highlighted settings to save.

reset.title: Reset advanced settings?
reset.body: Every setting on this page goes back to its default. Nothing changes until you save.
